test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question has two statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some hoops are cows.

All cows are bulls.

Conclusions:

(I) Some bulls are hoops.

(II) Some hoops are bulls.
solution:

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some bulls are hoops → **True **(As, Some hoops are cows, All cows are bulls. so, Some bulls are hoops is true)

(II) Some hoops are bulls →**True **(As, Some hoops are cows, All cows are bulls. so, Some bulls are hoops is true)

Thus, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
